content:
Continuing with \(a=pq^{-1}\) and \(b=p^{-1}q=\frac1a\):

\[
\frac{(a+1)^2}{a-b}\cdot (a-1)\div \frac{(a+1)(a^2-a+1)}{a+b-1}
\]

\[
= \frac{(a+1)^2(a-1)(a+b-1)}{(a-b)(a+1)(a^2-a+1)}
\]

\[
= \frac{(a+1)(a-1)(a+b-1)}{(a-b)(a^2-a+1)}
\]

Since \(b=\frac1a\),

\[
a+b-1 = a+\frac1a-1 = \frac{a^2-a+1}{a},
\]

and

\[
a-b = a-\frac1a = \frac{a^2-1}{a} = \frac{(a-1)(a+1)}{a}.
\]

Thus

\[
\frac{a+b-1}{a-b}
=
\frac{a^2-a+1}{(a-1)(a+1)}.
\]

So the expression becomes

\[
\frac{(a+1)(a-1)}{a^2-a+1}
\cdot
\frac{a^2-a+1}{(a-1)(a+1)}
=1.
\]

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
